notes.standard_policy: Core question can contribute normally to its policy dimension.
notes.lower_weight_or_stress_policy: Question is useful but contains a hypothetical, broader construct or additional trade-off, so V2 deliberately gives it less evidentiary weight.
notes.dealbreaker_probe: Measures sensitivity to a large conflict, never ideological direction.
notes.cross_dimension_policy: One answer creates separate scores on two policy dimensions.
notes.redesign_blockers: Questions that should not be active in scoring until structurally redesigned. V2 has none after the rebuild.

conclusion: The V2 bank has no known structural scoring blocker. Lower-weight questions remain intentionally marked because their wording or construct contains more modelling assumptions than direct policy questions. This is an internal methodological review, not psychometric or academic validation.
